entries.answer: Minimums apply per style: Custom orders 300 pairs or 200 bags; Private label 50 per style; Ready-to-brand catalogue 20 per style. Size and colour breakdowns may apply.
We offer three ways to order: Custom orders (our main focus), Private label, and a Ready-to-brand catalogue. Request a quote to start.
Quotes are in USD. Payment is 50% deposit to start production and 50% before shipment. Naira payments use the exchange rate on the day of payment, and the rate source is stated on the quote.
Goods are delivered to Lagos port (CIF Lagos). The buyer handles customs clearance and pays duties and levies. Door delivery in Lagos is a paid option. We deliver to Lagos only for now.
Samples and prototypes are available. Fee and credit terms are shared on request. Please request a quote or WhatsApp us for details.
You own your custom design. We do not produce branded replicas, and we only work with original designs or brands you have the right to use.
No account is needed to send a quote request or ask a question. Sign up on the My Account page to track your orders.
We reply within two working days, Lagos time. For faster questions, WhatsApp us.
Email sample@greenlink-demo.com or WhatsApp us. For a price or timeline, please request a quote.

fallback: I can only answer questions about our services, minimum orders, payment, delivery and accounts. For prices, timelines or anything else, please request a quote or WhatsApp us.
